description: Selected modernization tasks generated from assessment report report-20260824124049.

tasks.reason: Addresses issue: Java Version Has Reached the End of Support (2 assessment incidents).
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the full multi-module Maven reactor from its Java 8 compiler baseline to OpenJDK 21, the required target. Preserve public behavior and resolve build, test, plugin, and dependency compatibility issues caused by the runtime change.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgraded the 24-module Maven reactor from Java 8 to Java 21 LTS. Compiler source/target set to 21 in root pom.xml. maven-surefire-plugin upgraded 2.19→3.2.5. All 271 tests passed at task completion (session 20260824144409). Build confirmed by javac [debug target 21] in final validation run.

tasks.reason: Addresses issue: Jakarta EE Version is not the latest stable (25 assessment incidents).
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the selected Java EE/Jakarta EE usage across affected modules to the latest stable Jakarta EE release compatible with OpenJDK 21. Preserve connector APIs and behavior while resolving removed or incompatible APIs and dependencies.
tasks.taskSummary: Migrated javax.mail→angus-mail:2.0.3, Jetty 9→12 EE10, woodstox-core-asl (Codehaus EOL)→com.fasterxml.woodstox:woodstox-core:6.6.2, commons-vfs2 2.1→2.9.0. All 25 Jakarta EE incidents resolved. Build and all tests passed (session 20260824144409, confirmed session 20260825113414).

tasks.reason: Addresses issues: Deprecation of Locale Class Constructors; java.net.URL Constructors Are Deprecated; Deprecation of SecurityPermission 'insertProvider.{name}' in Favor of 'insertProvider' (12 assessment incidents).
tasks.requirements: Replace only the selected deprecated Locale constructors, java.net.URL constructors, and SecurityPermission insertProvider.{name} usages with supported equivalents. Preserve observable behavior and compatibility with the upgraded Java and Jakarta EE baselines.
tasks.taskSummary: Replaced all deprecated new Locale() constructors (22 sites, 8 files) with Locale.of()/Locale.ROOT, new URL(String) with URI.create().toURL(), and removed dead insertProvider.{name} SecurityPermission code (SecurityManager removed in Java 17). All 12 deprecated API incidents resolved. 293 tests passed (session 20260825113414).

tasks.description: Migrate from Eclipse Project to Maven Project
tasks.reason: Addresses issue: Eclipse project found (86 assessment incidents and 49 Eclipse metadata files in the workspace).
tasks.requirements: Complete the Maven configuration needed for the Eclipse-to-Maven migration using the existing multi-module Maven reactor. Preserve every .project and .classpath file unchanged: do not modify, delete, rename, or regenerate any of them. Create or update Maven configuration as required to represent source, resource, generated-source, and dependency settings.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Use the repository's existing root Maven reactor and module pom.xml files.
tasks.taskSummary: Removed Eclipse-derived explicit source-directory, output-directory, and resource declarations from identity4j-script-ssh, identity4j-script-http, identity4j-script-hypersocket; replaced with Maven conventions. Added standard Maven entries to root .gitignore. Fixed parent-version mismatches (sessions eclipse-project-to-maven-project-20260824165934, eclipse-project-to-maven-project-20260825125847). All 49 .project and .classpath files remain byte-for-byte unchanged (verified git diff develop HEAD: 0 diffs).

tasks.description: Scan and resolve the selected CWE vulnerabilities
tasks.reason: Addresses the 22 CWE findings explicitly selected from assessment report report-20260824124049.
tasks.requirements: Scan and remediate exactly CWE-130, CWE-477, CWE-570, CWE-665, CWE-681, CWE-682, CWE-775, CWE-783, CWE-789, CWE-543, CWE-567, CWE-662, CWE-667, CWE-820, CWE-821, CWE-259, CWE-321, CWE-778, CWE-798, CWE-22, CWE-23, and CWE-611. Use the evidence and affected files in the existing report, add focused regression tests for each changed behavior, and exclude unselected CWE-89 and CWE-502.
tasks.taskSummary: All 22 selected CWEs remediated across dedicated sessions: CWE-130 (length validation in AESEncoder/PBEWithMD5AndDESEncoder, 18 regression tests), CWE-477 (obsolete function removal), CWE-570 (always-false guards removed), CWE-665/CWE-681/CWE-682 (arithmetic/initialization fixes), CWE-775 (12 files, try-with-resources), CWE-783 (operator precedence parentheses), CWE-789 (AES key bounds guards), CWE-543/CWE-567/CWE-662/CWE-667/CWE-820/CWE-821 (synchronization hardening with volatile/synchronized/double-checked-locking), CWE-259/CWE-321/CWE-798 (credential and key externalization), CWE-778 (security logging added to 7 files), CWE-22/CWE-23 (zip-slip and path-traversal fixes with canonical path enforcement), CWE-611 (XXE suppression in two XML factories). Regression tests added for all CWE fixes. CWE-89 and CWE-502 excluded per plan scope. Build and all tests passed after each remediation.

tasks.reason: Addresses all 107 CVE/GHSA dependency findings in assessment report report-20260824124049.

Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions; for required major upgrades, document the dependency, version change, compatibility risk, and any accepted exception. Re-scan after remediation and verify the full reactor build and unit tests.
